Per Fig. 5: R1 (3.5 cm), R2 (310 cm), R3 (12.5 or 25 cm), R4 (200 cm); flows: dibromopyridine 6.00, first n-BuLi 1.50, E1 3.00, second n-BuLi 2.25, E2 4.00/5.00/6.00 → total 16.75/17.75/18.75 mL/min. Residence time tR1 = 0.46 s corresponds to R1 only (first Br/Li exchange), thus using only initial streams: 6.00 + 1.50 + 3.00 = 10.5 mL/min → internal volume of R1 = 10.5 mL/min × 0.46 s / 60 s/min ≈ 0.0805 mL; matches geometry (ID=500 µm, L=3.5 cm → vol≈0.0069 mL? discrepancy suggests tR1 is calculated from full flow including all streams entering R1 — but per Fig. 5, only dibromopyridine + first n-BuLi enter R1; E1 enters at M2 after R1. So R1 flow = 6.00 + 1.50 = 7.5 mL/min → 0.46 s × 7.5 / 60 = 0.0575 mL; ID=500 µm → radius=0.025 cm, area=πr²≈0.00196 cm², length=3.5 cm → vol≈0.00686 cm³=0.00686 mL → t = V/Q = 0.00686 mL / (7.5 mL/min / 60 s/min) = 0.0549 s — inconsistent with stated 0.46 s. Therefore, reported tR1 values are nominal/adjusted; we retain as-is from table. Productivity 4.85 g/h reported for this entry.
